title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 083
review_goal: Differentiate scissors, server, and settings variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Sideways scissors with two finger loops on the left and two cutting blades crossing toward the right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the scissors laid out horizontally rather than standing upright or tilted.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the upright or rotated scissors when the handles should not sit clearly to the left of the blades.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot flips the scissors into a left to right cutting pose instead of an upward pointing pose.

items.depicts_observation: Rectangular server rack with two horizontal bays and two small status dots in the lower bay
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a clear stacked rack server with shelf like horizontal divisions.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the rounded server appliance when the machine should not taper or soften around the top corners.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot reads as a straight rectangular rack with shelf lines and bottom status lights.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded server body with a tapered top shell and two small status lights near the lower center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a softer standalone server body instead of a flat rectangular rack with shelf dividers.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the rack server when the machine should be drawn as two stacked rectangular bays.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot swaps the rack shelves for one rounded appliance body with a softer top profile.

items.depicts_observation: Three horizontal slider bars with one round knob on each bar instead of a gear wheel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants settings to read as adjustable controls rather than a gear mechanism.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the gear wheel when the settings cue should be toothed and circular instead of linear sliders.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot turns settings into three slider controls instead of a toothed gear.

items.depicts_observation: Circular gear wheel with a center hub and short teeth spaced around the outer rim
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the familiar gear symbol rather than slider based tuning controls.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the slider settings when the cue should not be a round toothed wheel.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is a compact gear with teeth around the rim instead of three horizontal slider bars.
